name: Escalation Chain
description_short: Students pass a short story down a chain of retellings, each person adding one deliberate exaggeration - then compare the wildly escalated ending to the original.
teacher_note: Genuine listening pressure with a built-in payoff - the gap between round one and the final retelling is usually the funniest five minutes of the lesson. Needs the chain to move student to student without everyone hearing every step at once, so this one's classroom-only.
creator: Free Range Tutors
internal_notes: setting deliberately kept as classroom, not either, per the build brief: the chain depends on retellings happening sequentially, out of simultaneous earshot of the whole group. A synchronous video call collapses that (everyone hears every retelling at once), and breakout rooms aren't something FRT can assume every teacher has configured, so this isn't claimed as online-compatible.
